There's no MOH minimum rest between shifts to put in — MOH sets none, so this is a recommended rest practice, not a legal rule. (The law is 1 rest day a week, at most 12 working hours a day, 44 hours a week averaged over 3 weeks for shift workers, and at most 72 hours of overtime a month.)

What wards usually record instead is a shift-order rule in their own words:
